Thus H(F)<7I_ctrl+H_leaf, genuine minority/KL debt plus H_leaf<=4I_ctrl+H_leaf, and its full 3mu/ln2 allowance plus H_leaf<9I_ctrl+H_leaf. A more general sufficient local condition for a fresh point event against any independent residual event of probability q is a(1-q)>e/8. Common coordinates and the shared core are paid once.
